data.name: Enshrouding Darkness
data.description: You can touch an ally and bestow a darkness blessing. For 1 minute, the ally becomes enshrouded in shadows while in combat, granting it concealment (20%%). Creatures that are normally able to see in supernatural darkness ignore this concealment.
